How to Use Budget Birdie

Budget Birdie is a simple and intuitive tool that helps you manage your finances effectively. To get started, simply enter your income and expenses into the calculator. This will provide you with a clear overview of your financial situation, allowing you to make informed decisions about your spending and saving habits.

1. Gather your financial information, including your monthly income, regular expenses, and any other relevant financial details.

2. Enter your income and expenses into the appropriate input fields and category section to build your personal budget.

3. Review your totals and spending breakdown to gain a clear understanding of your finances and identify opportunities to save more.
